# Now 2.13.1
- Fixed jittery lyric scrolling in the full-screen view. The animated album-art background was using an expensive per-frame blur that saturated the GPU; it now uses lightweight gradient shaders for the same soft, drifting glow at a fraction of the cost, so line changes scroll smoothly again.

# Now 2.13.0
- Word-by-word (karaoke) lyrics now work for Apple Music too, using its built-in syllable timing — brightness sweeps across each word as it's sung. - Romanization under non-Latin lyrics: songs written in Devanagari, Hangul, kana, hanzi, Cyrillic and more now show a dimmer romanized (Latin) line beneath each lyric. It's done entirely on-device — no network, fully private — so it works for any script and any song. Lyrics already in the Latin alphabet are unchanged.

# Now 2.12.0
- Word-by-word (karaoke) lyrics in the full-screen view: when a track has word-level timing available, brightness sweeps across each word in time with the vocal, Apple-Music-style. Songs without word timing keep the normal line highlight. - Word timing loads quietly in the background and upgrades the lyrics in place, so lyrics still appear instantly and only get richer when the data is there.
